operating_objective_input.provenance_quote: i feel like this list of what the system should do needs to be included in the roadmap. that really makes it clear what the objectives are
operating_objective_input.cutover_question: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
objectives: Understand business and system state visually within seconds.
Perform routine work through straightforward controls.
Ask Doc for clarification without starting an engineering session.
See what agents are doing, which agent is acting, current phase, exact scope, and why.
Approve consequential changes through clear, exact action cards.
Queue improvements for Claude Code or Codex without supervising the entire build conversation.
Receive verified outcomes, evidence, blockers, and history back in the interface.
Open a heavy Claude Code or Codex session only when exploring, investigating a genuinely complex problem, or constructing something new.
baseline_measures_without_invented_value: Joe’s current weekly time spent using heavy AI sessions for routine system/business operation
Count and categories of routine questions that require Claude/Codex explanation
Count and categories of recurring actions that cannot be completed visually
Median time to determine business state and system health
Number of hand-carried context transfers between sessions
council_criteria: Require instrumentation or interview before baseline values exist
Bind every baseline to a product action and a like-for-like post-launch comparison
Do not treat heavy AI use for exploration, complex investigation, or new construction as a product failure
Do not retire a routine surface until the exact cutover question is answered yes by uncoached evidence

settled_inputs.decision: Google route optimization supports locked appointments; CARR owns a native Tour Notebook; Goodnotes is optional share interoperability.

settled_inputs.decision: Neon-backed records are canonical; Salesforce is provenance/upstream paperwork; all UI and exported artifacts are projections.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: explicit data-governance decision replaces the canonical record layer

settled_inputs.decision: Phase 0 discovery, contracts, prototypes, and inventories may continue; production construction begins only after Joe approves the council output.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: Joe explicitly authorizes a new scope

settled_inputs.decision: The canonical planning set is Workspace, Control Room, and Mature Software End State, governed by the Production Maturity Baseline.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: a later durable decision explicitly replaces the integrated planning set

settled_inputs.decision: October 5, 2026 and eight weeks target CARR Mature Foundation v1, while production-mature web, Mac parity, iPhone, iPad Tour Mode, and safely mutable AgentOps remain a 4–6-month evidence-gated program.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: fresh measured delivery evidence supports an explicit durable revision

settled_inputs.decision: Launch has exactly one owner-controlled CARR tenant and Joe/Dell only; tenant context is server-derived and public SaaS, signup, tenant selector, client portal, billing, and self-service tenant creation are excluded.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: Joe explicitly authorizes a later owner-controlled tenant or seat licensing phase after isolation evidence

settled_inputs.decision: Workflow versions are tenant-bound and immutable and graduate experimental, pilot, approved, standard, retired; promotion uses a trial of no more than five business days, exact evidence, rollback, cutover, and Joe approval, and the trial creates no new source of truth, destructive migration, parallel writer, or generic workflow engine. Generic workflow engines, plugin marketplaces, customer scripting, and customer-authored executable workflows are excluded.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: new evidence supports an explicit owner-approved lifecycle revision without weakening locked rails

settled_inputs.decision: Normal internal maintenance targets three to five human hours per month; the observed baseline remains unknown until measured and every exception is separately attributed. More than five normal internal maintenance hours in each of two consecutive months creates prioritized toil-reduction work. A low-toil or mature claim requires three complete consecutive normal months at three to five hours with required control evidence intact and exceptions reported separately.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: measured evidence supports an explicit target revision

settled_inputs.decision: Joe retains platform, intellectual property, source, infrastructure, security policy, and roadmap control; corporate may license owner-controlled seats only as a customer.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: Joe explicitly changes the ownership or licensing model

settled_inputs.decision: Organization tenant, sponsoring human/partner, runtime agent principal, session capability profile, and personal brain scope/version/counts are separate immutable server-derived dimensions. Sponsor selects only the matching brain; runtime agent retains attribution; personal rules cannot select tenant or grant capability; unsponsored agents are task-scoped only; missing scope fails visibly; connector and fallback must agree.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: A later explicit security decision provides evidence of an equally strict separation without cross-brain, attribution, tenant, or capability ambiguity.

settled_inputs.decision: Workers Paid is active for the CARR Worker as of 2026-08-11, closing the immediate free-tier-versus-paid-capacity choice. OAuth/session KV instrumentation, duplicate-write reduction, headroom thresholds, alerting, cost observation, and outage recovery remain required production-readiness evidence.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: Measured cost, consistency, latency, or capacity evidence supports an explicit storage or tier redesign.
